## 1. Article System Improvements (detailed)

This is a structural refactor of the article demo component system, changing from a single monolithic `components.tsx` file to a `components/` directory pattern (one file per demo).

**Plop scaffolding:**
- `plop-templates/article/components.tsx.hbs` -- **deleted**. The old template that scaffolded a single `"use client"` file with all demos.
- `plop-templates/article/components-index.ts.hbs` -- **new**. Replacement template that scaffolds a barrel `index.ts` in a `components/` directory.
- `plopfile.js` -- Updated the `add` action from `article/components.tsx` to `article/components/index.ts` using the new template.
- `plop-templates/article/page.tsx.hbs` -- Updated the comment block to reference the `components/` directory pattern instead of `components.tsx`.

**Shared MDX/UI components (mobile + polish):**
- `ExperimentNav.tsx` -- Nav now spans `right-4 left-4` (full width on mobile). Button labels shortened to "Back" / "Article" / "Experiment" on `sm:hidden`, with full text on `sm:inline`. Icons get `shrink-0`.
- `ArticleLayout.tsx` -- Removed breadcrumb nav entirely. Changed padding from `py-16` to `pt-20 pb-10` (mobile) / `sm:py-16`. Prev/next nav changed from `flex-row` to `flex-col` on mobile with `sm:flex-row`.
- `experiments.css` -- `scrollbar-gutter: stable` moved behind `@media (min-width: 640px)` to prevent layout shift on mobile. `figure:not(:first-child)` margin now scoped to `figure[data-rehype-pretty-code-figure]` so non-code figures aren't affected. Added `.katex-display` margin + `overflow-x: auto` for math rendering.
- `CodeBlock.tsx` -- Copy button changed from `opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100` to always-visible with `transition-colors` (mobile can't hover).
- `HeadingLink.tsx` -- Anchor link now shows on `focus:opacity-100`, hidden on mobile with `max-sm:hidden`.
- `PageActions.tsx` -- Container gets `flex-wrap` so buttons wrap on narrow viewports.
- `ControlGroup.tsx` -- New `compact` boolean prop. When true, multi-column layouts keep their column count on mobile instead of collapsing to 1.

**Content system docs (references updated to `components/` pattern):**
- `.agents/contexts/content-constellation.md` -- File tree updated from `components.tsx` to `components/` directory with `index.ts`, `utils.ts`, `DemoOne.tsx`, `DemoTwo.tsx`. Added "Demo component decomposition" pattern description.
- `.agents/workflows/publish-experiment.md` -- Phase 2 step 7 rewritten: one file per demo, shared helpers in `utils.ts`, barrel export from `index.ts`, 200/300 line limits.
- `.cursor/agents/content-writer.md` -- Added new "Demo Component Decomposition" subsection under Technical Constraints.
- `.cursor/rules/article-writing.mdc` -- MDX wiring steps updated from 4 to 5 steps (added barrel re-export step). Added "Demo Component Decomposition" subsection.
- `.cursor/skills/publish-content/SKILL.md` -- Updated scaffold output list, build demos instructions, and verification checklist.

---

## 2. Non-Euclidean Hyperbolic Workspace Article (detailed)

Full content constellation for the hyperbolic workspace experiment.

**New article files (all untracked):**
- `article/page.tsx` -- MDX rendering page, wires 5 demo components into the MDX component map.
- `article/content.mdx` -- ~168-line article covering Poincaré disk geometry, Möbius transforms, geodesic arcs, conformal scaling, and hyperbolic tree layout. Uses 5 interactive demos inline.
- `article/components/index.ts` -- Barrel export for all 5 demos.
- `article/components/utils.ts` -- ~189 lines of shared math: Poincaré disk ↔ screen coordinate transforms, geodesic arc computation, Möbius transform application, hyperbolic midpoint, tree layout in hyperbolic space.
- `article/components/EuclideanVsHyperbolicDemo.tsx` -- Side-by-side Canvas 2D comparison of Euclidean vs hyperbolic grids.
- `article/components/MobiusTransformDemo.tsx` -- Interactive Möbius transform visualization with draggable origin point.
- `article/components/GeodesicDemo.tsx` -- Shows geodesic arcs (circular arcs orthogonal to the boundary) vs straight lines.
- `article/components/ConformalScaleDemo.tsx` -- ~163 lines. Demonstrates conformal scale factor `2/(1-|z|²)` with interactive point placement.
- `article/components/HyperbolicTreeDemo.tsx` -- ~168 lines. Interactive tree layout on the Poincaré disk with draggable root node.

**New docs files (all untracked):**
- `docs/lab-note.md`, `docs/architecture.md`, `docs/snippet.md`, `docs/social.md`, `docs/changelog.md` -- Full content constellation docs.

**Layout refactor (modified):**
- `layout.tsx` -- Hardcoded metadata strings replaced with `experiment.json` field references. Added `ThemeProvider` wrapper, `font-canvas` class, `suppressHydrationWarning`, `tags` prop to `ExperimentJsonLd`. Poster path now computed dynamically.

**Registry update (modified):**
- `public/registry/non-euclidean-hyperbolic-workspace.json` -- Minor content change in `HyperbolicInfoModal.tsx` serialized component.

---

## 3. Article Prose Polish

Three existing articles had em-dash/punctuation cleanup -- replacing `--` joiners and dangling clauses with colons, semicolons, or restructured sentences. Pure copyedit, no structural changes.

- `404-not-found/article/content.mdx` -- ~10 punctuation edits
- `basketball-replay-center/article/content.mdx` -- ~3 punctuation edits
- `velocity-responsive-design/article/content.mdx` -- ~13 punctuation edits

---

## 4. Continual Learning Migration

Moved from `.agents/skills/` + `.cursor/hooks/` to `.cursor/skills/`:
- **Deleted**: `.agents/skills/continual-learning/SKILL.md`, `.cursor/hooks/continual-learning-start.mjs`, `.cursor/hooks/continual-learning-stop.mjs`
- **Modified**: `.cursor/hooks.json` (removed hook entries), `.cursor/settings.json` (removed related settings)
- **New**: `.cursor/skills/continual-learning/SKILL.md`
- **Modified**: `AGENTS.md` -- moved `continual-learning` from `.agents/skills` list to `.cursor/skills` list

---

## 5. Docs & README Overhaul

- `README.md` -- Full rewrite. From generic "playground" intro to structured reference: tech stack table, project structure tree, key concepts (experiments, content system, registry), links to new `docs/` guides.
- `CONTRIBUTING.md` -- Replaced step-by-step with quick reference commands + links to `docs/contributing.md`.
- `memory.md` -- Pruned ~38 lines of stale/one-off facts (registry V2 completion notes, collected component trivia, etc.), kept durable workspace patterns.
- `docs/` -- **11 new files**: architecture, getting-started, experiments, content-system, registry, toolkit, deploy, scripts, contributing, ai-development, README.
- `.github/pull_request_template.md` -- New PR template.

---

## 6. Package Metadata

- `package.json` -- Added `description`, `homepage`, `repository`, `license`, `author`, `keywords` fields.
- `package-lock.json` -- Regenerated (182 lines of diff, likely from the metadata change propagation).

---

## 7. Generated Outputs

- `public/llms.txt` -- Added non-euclidean-hyperbolic-workspace article entry.
- `public/llms-full.txt` -- Added article section + article links in experiment listing.

---

## 8. Cursor Plans

4 new `.cursor/plans/*.plan.md` files (article_components_decomposition, hyperbolic_components_split, hyperbolic_content_constellation, readme_and_docs_overhaul). Execution logs from the work above.

---
